semantic_review: Forward semantics are defined independently of scalar Expr evaluation, then bridged by the compiler theorems.
Attention uses actual signed Q/K/V affine projections, scaled QK products, coupled row softmax over fixed nonempty injective supports, AV multiplication, and output projection.
The block has actual input-dependent positive-epsilon LayerNorm before attention and before the signed two-affine-layer feed-forward network, with two residual additions.
Each block can have its own finite head list, key/value dimensions, hidden width, and supported activation; blocks form an arbitrary finite list.
The whole network includes positional input bias, optional final LayerNorm, and an ungated signed affine logit readout.
No record field assumes reconstruction, convexity, monotonicity, or an entire Transformer property. Stored proof fields are genuine positive-dimension/epsilon and mask-validity conditions.

contracts.authorship: Expected full-forall types were manually written from source statements and the intended mathematical interfaces, not copied from inferred Lean types.

boundary_consumers: A concrete injective causal mask has one key at query zero and two keys at query one.
A genuine singleton attention head with constant Value three and nonzero output weight evaluates to three.
A block with attention, both LayerNorm positions, GELU syntax, signed biases and residuals evaluates to x minus two.
The zero-depth network evaluates to 1 minus 3x; the two-block network evaluates to 13 minus 3x, including signed affine logits.
Compilation equality is consumed for a concrete two-block network.
Optional final LayerNorm with zero variance, positive epsilon, negative gain and bias seven produces the expected final logit minus twenty-six; its compiled equality is consumed.
scope_limits: This module establishes the explicit pre-LayerNorm architecture and its compiler equivalence; the DC regularity/reconstruction theorems are in the separate expression/correctness modules.
Inputs are continuous real token embeddings, not discrete token indices.
Post-LayerNorm, adaptive masks, stochastic training-time dropout and positional transformations other than the defined bias are not separately modeled here.
The compiler produces symbolic expression trees; no arithmetic-DAG size, executable floating-point accuracy or numerical stability guarantee follows.

initial_boundary_failure.reason: Audit fixture elaboration: dependent Fin index coercions and simplification of a singleton dependent head list. Production source was unchanged; corrected consumer passed.
